problem: Frozen v1 promotion rejects every nonempty unresolved_issues field. Revised reviewers recommend include but record missing future patch validation and bounded-scope limitations there. Patch execution cannot precede isolated patch generation, which itself requires case promotion.
proposed_generation_eligibility: All three fresh reviewers explicitly approve the same finite source-grounded case, bounded scope, concrete fixtures and actual qualified validation capability.
All three fresh reviewers report zero substantive case-selection blockers.

Classify each concern as a substantive selection blocker, a precisely bounded disclosed limitation, a required later validation obligation, or a historical statement superseded by exact newer execution evidence.
Require explicit adjudication of every disagreement and preserve issue text and supporting pins; no automatic keyword classification or silent issue removal.
Additional-host uncertainty is a blocker if a required affected host is missing. Scope may claim only evidenced frozen hosts; no general copybook preservation claim.
Dependent cases retain original group IDs and case-versus-bundle accounting. Independent contribution cannot be claimed without evidence.
Unsupported regulation, insufficient source scope, empty or unavailable required fixtures, missing compiler identity and contradictory baselines remain selection blockers.
proposed_protocol: Additive prospectively frozen nonhuman stage-aware review protocol, schema and loader; fresh complete primary/verifier/adjudicator chains for affected inputs
required_later_validation: Post-generation patch scope, clean application, parser integrity, call graph/dataflow/slice consistency, compiler execution, intended behavior, unaffected regression behavior, affected-host fanout and exact source binding remain mandatory R2.7-R2.8 checks.
Every failed patch, abstention, unavailable check and infrastructure failure remains visible; generation eligibility does not establish successful remediation.
No complete equivalence, universal compliance, broader untested fanout or independent-case uncertainty claim follows from finite fixtures.
retention: Keep every original and revised request, response, capture, runtime archive and v1 acceptance rule unchanged.
New requests use new schema, protocol and run-key identities; completed provider keys are not rerun or relabeled.
Keep the detector-led track inactive and oracle-assisted results separate.
Do not mark R2 complete by publishing an empty roster caused solely by this stage-contract mismatch.
